notes.title: Quality of Life and a new tile!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for the love this past week. Launch has been great. I've added some new features that I thought would be really cool!

Changes:


 Added screen mode and resolution options
 Added Discord and Twitter button (yes I chose the bird icon)
 Added a 7% chance of a sword appearing inside the rock object
 Added new water object: river corner


Fixes:


 Color palette button now has a proper description (translated as well)

notes.title: April Fools Update (can be disabled)
notes.content:
Hello Kings & Queens,

It is April Fools today, so I figured to celebrate the 1 week since launch for Le Château, I would make this super cozy experience temporarily a super intense experience; a clicker game. Place buildings like how you always would. But...keep clicking them...because otherwise they will slowly shrink >:)

Enjoy!

(it can be disabled by pressing the enabled button in the bottom left! happy building!)

TheShelfman

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changes:


Tutorial step about achievement panel no longer blocks the button text preview at the bottom of the screen


Fixes:


Fixed Color palette button staying in place rather than moving to the edge of the screen
Fixed achievements sometimes not being recognized and therefore unlocking tiles (I really hope it’s been fixed!)
Fixed Ocean Time achievement tiles already being unlocked from the start
Fixed 11 tile world achievement unlocking 9, 7, and 5 tile world achievement as well (same for 9 unlocking 7 and 5, and 7 unlocking 5)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes:

Changed stable default rotation by 90 degrees
Changed default order in which objects is shown
After placing an object, it no longer automatically switches to the next object in line
Added a sound that plays with every tutorial step popup
Tutorial step on rotating the world now requires you to rotate the world twice
When it’s raining, the background is now darker, and there’s a 50% chance that the lighting is also darker
Added button that allows you to change the current color palette



Fixes:

Screenshot button is now also available after build is finished
Rain sound effect now loops
Snow sound effect now loops
Fixed worlds looking weird when spawning tiles on a rotated world in the tutorial
Fixed 1 tile circle world build animations not working

notes.title: Le Château on Steam Next Fest - October 9
notes.content:
👑Greetings Kings & Queens👑

Special announcement today! Development has been going strong, and some cool new features have been added, but even better is that SOON™ you'll be able to experience them yourself!

Le Château will be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest where upcoming games are celebrated by having thousands of demos available to play. This means that Le Chateau will have a demo of its own!
I've been working hard to make it happen (and to see what even works as a demo for a game like this one), and in the end I decided to make it come down to this:


 1 hour of playtime (it's a lot, I believe, so you should be fine! Infinite just seemed too much for this game)
 2 out of 3 world shapes are available
 20 available tiles (17 of which will have to be unlocked by playing: specifics will be shared through a guide probably)


This should all be enough to allow you to make breathtaking kingdoms without feeling restricted to the available features.

I still have some other features in mind to add later, and a bunch of tiles that would be cool to add, but of course that will be for the full version, which I'm hoping to release later this year.

Feel free to ask any questions, I'll gladly answer them!

🏰King Shelfu out (I don't know how I feel about that line but okay)
